name: Hibino Hikari
source:
Ikumi's friend at the photography shop. When Ikumi becomes a girl she quickly tells Hikari of her situation. Hikari decides to treat her the same regardless of her gender.

She works with Mana in helping Ikumi buy and wear girl clothes and behave like a proper girl.
